description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of narrative media framing across different political biases in political discourse, with four distinct categories represented. The largest segment, colored blue, corresponds to "Right bias" and accounts for 30.0% (n = 30) of the total. The second largest segment, in orange, represents "Left bias" and makes up 28.0% (n = 28). The "Left center bias" category, shown in red, constitutes 20.0% (n = 20) of the distribution. The smallest segment, in green, is labeled "Left center bias" and represents 22.0% (n = 22). Each slice includes its percentage and sample size in parentheses, and the chart is visually ordered with the largest slice at the top right and the others following in a clockwise direction. There is no legend provided, as the labels are directly placed on the respective slices.
